244	Not new behaviour. The same behaviour, without the seams.

246	- [ ] **Every loading state.** Anywhere the app currently shows nothing, a

251	  screens with nothing on them are the strongest "unfinished" signal an app has.
252	- [ ] **Every error state.** Offline, request failed, session expired. A retry
253	  affordance, never a raw error string, never a silent nothing.
254	- [ ] **Transitions.** Sheets, tab switches, screen pushes. One easing curve and
255	  one duration set used everywhere. Inconsistent motion is the thing people read
256	  as cheap without being able to name it.

258	  element. Audit all of them; list what you changed.

267	
268	- [ ] **One type scale, one spacing scale, one radius scale.** Find every
269	  hardcoded px value in the CSS, replace with tokens, delete the outliers. List
270	  how many distinct font sizes existed before and after.
271	- [ ] **Kill every leftover orange.** The accent is `#7B5CFA`. Grep for amber,
272	  orange, and any hex that isn't in the token set.
273	- [ ] **Contrast to WCAG AA** on every text-on-background pair. Report the ratios
274	  you had to change.
275	- [ ] **Copy pass, screen by screen.** Shorter, plainer, no marketing voice
276	  inside the product. No exclamation marks. Sentence case throughout. Every
277	  button says what happens, not "Continue".
278	- [ ] **Icon set consistency** — one stroke weight, one corner radius, one
279	  optical size across every icon in `components/Icons.tsx`.
280

282	
283	Read-only. Write findings to `RESEARCH.md`. **Do not implement anything you find
284	here**; add it to section E as a proposal and leave it unchecked for me.
285	
286	- [ ] **Competitor teardown.** Look at how comparable apps handle onboarding
287	  length, the paywall moment, the daily home screen, and how they present
288	  evidence. Cronometer, MyFitnessPal, Zoe, Bevel, Gyroscope, Oura's app, Rise,
289	  Athletic Greens' app. For each: what they do at the paywall, how many screens
290	  before value, and one thing they do better than us.
291	- [ ] **Premium-feel teardown.** Separately, list what actually makes an app feel
292	  expensive — motion, density, typography, restraint, empty space — and score our
293	  screens against each. Be specific and unkind.
294	- [ ] **App Store rejection risk pass.** Read the guidelines and go screen by
295	  screen. Anything touching 1.4.2, 3.1.1, 4.8, or health claims. Report only.
296	
297	## E. Proposals (do not implement)
298	
299	Anything you want to change that adds behaviour, removes a screen, or alters the
300	product goes here as an unchecked line with a one-paragraph case. I will decide
301	in the morning.
302	
303	- [ ] _(add proposals here)_
304	
305	- [ ] **Give the catalogue a `source` column, and exclude on it.** The diet
306	  table in `PROMPT_PERSONALISATION.md` moves nutrients up and swaps forms, but
307	  it never excludes a product for containing the animal the user just said they
308	  do not eat. So a vegan who picks Training is still shown Biochem 100% Whey
309	  Isolate, and a vegan who picks Skin is still shown Vital Proteins Collagen
310	  Peptides — whey is dairy and collagen is bovine or marine, always. That is the
311	  most visible way this feature can contradict itself, and it is exactly what
312	  section 5's twenty runs are meant to catch. I did not fix it because the fix
313	  is not a rule, it is data: nothing on a glossary row says what a product is
314	  made from, and deriving it from the name is guesswork the moment a product is
315	  called "Ultimate Omega" rather than "Fish Oil". Proposal: add
316	  `source text[] null` to `glossary` (`dairy | egg | fish | shellfish | bovine |
317	  porcine | none`), populate it in the 176-product migration where the label
318	  says so, and let the diet answers exclude on it with the same "swapped out,
319	  and here is why" line the form swaps already use. Roughly one migration
320	  column, one lookup table and four lines in `recommend.ts`.
321	
322	- [ ] **Decide what "No red meat" on its own should do.** It is an option on
323	  the diet screen and it is the only one that currently changes nothing:
324	  the table in the spec names `no-meat` for the iron and zinc rules, so someone
325	  who ticks only "No red meat" gets exactly the recommendations of someone who
326	  eats everything. Red meat is the main source of haem iron, so a smaller iron
327	  nudge is arguably right — but the spec is deliberate about which answers move
328	  which products, and inventing a weight for this one is the kind of thing that
329	  should be your call rather than mine at 3am.
